collection: Official document pages fetched as raw HTML via curl; their Next.js server-rendered RSC payload contains article body. Egress region unknown. No product sign-in or live model execution.

sources.name: 模型配置与使用
evidence: Settings > Assistant configuration > Models: Team, Mine, Shared by others.
Mine > Add model: interface, model ID, base URL, API key, context, output limit, image input.
Get model list after interface, URL and key; model selector beside conversation input.
Default applies to new conversations; reasoning depth only for supported models.
Sharing personal models leaves upstream charges with owner; recipients cannot edit or reshare.

sources.name: 团队资源配置与分发
evidence: Resource management > Models > System models > Add model.
For text models context and output limits must be positive.
All, selected groups, selected users; parent group grant includes child groups.
Refresh model list after save; provider charges and internal credits separate.

sources.name: 模型、技能与连接器问题
evidence: Empty model list: correct workspace and authorization.
Failed call: interface address, API key, model name, reachability, balance and supported parameters.

sources.name: Pinned current MonkeyAI administrator models UI source
evidence: OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic are distinct text protocol choices.
Text context entry is labeled K; submitted field is multiplied by 1000.
Current validation requires positive context, max output and credit multiplier, and authorization selection.

limitations: The pages describe the observed version; UI labels, model protocols and provider capabilities may change.
We did not authenticate, configure models, obtain keys, send prompts, or test network connectivity to model providers.
The administrator React form does not establish that every save runs a health check; no such claim was made.
Interface compatibility does not establish feature compatibility, model availability, pricing or region availability.
The official text is referenced and summarized; guides are independently written and are not full official translations.
